schema.question: Which station gains the most bikes on average when it rains, compared with dry hours?
schema.answer: Hanover Quay East gains the most bikes when it rains, with about 26 more bikes on average during rainy hours than dry ones. Herbert Street is next at roughly 25, followed by Grand Canal Dock at about 24.

schema.question: For city-centre stations, what is the average number of available bikes during peak hours versus outside peak hours?
schema.answer: For city-centre stations, peak hours average about 13.5 available bikes per station-hour, while outside peak hours the average is about 12.0 available bikes. So peak periods actually show slightly more bikes on hand at central stations in this dataset.
schema.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN a.is_peak_hour THEN 'peak' ELSE 'off-peak' END AS period, ROUND(CAST(AVG(a.avg_available_bikes) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_available_bikes FROM marts.agg_station_hourly AS a JOIN marts.dim_station AS d ON d.station_id = a.station_id WHERE d.zone ILIKE '%cent%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

schema.question: What is the average temperature during peak hours compared with off-peak hours?
schema.answer: Across observed station-hours, peak hours average 8.71 °C while off-peak hours average 9.55 °C, so peak hours run about 0.84 degrees cooler. Note this is a simple average of hourly station readings (1,220 off-peak station-hours versus 113 peak ones), so peak coverage is much sparser.
schema.sql: SELECT is_peak_hour, ROUND(CAST(AVG(avg_temperature_c) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS avg_temp_c, COUNT(*) AS station_hours FROM marts.agg_station_hourly WHERE avg_temperature_c IS NOT NULL GROUP BY is_peak_hour ORDER BY is_peak_hour LIMIT 200
